spanish: y desde Bamot el valle que en campo de Moab, cabeza de la Pisgá, y mira sobre faces del Yeshimón.

findings.issue: Definite common noun (Ncmsa) is Hebraized and capitalized as the proper name Yeshimón; the token licenses a Spanish common noun.
Niphal feminine singular participle is smoothed to the finite verb mira.

notes: Bamot, Moab, and la Pisgá match the proper-noun tokens; faces keeps the plural construct.
